headline: RapWire 24/7: Ice Cube, Vic Mensa, Trippie Redd, The Weeknd and GTA VI
body: RapWire’s verified Nov. 2 evening carousel follows Ice Cube and Mike Epps’ Listen & Laugh trailer, Vic Mensa’s producer-led 2027 album, Trippie Redd’s NDA Tour opening, The Weeknd’s Hong Kong release, and fresh GTA VI gameplay shown through South Park. Every slide pairs source-grounded reporting with original late-1980s editorial comic art, readable headline/deck layers, clear subjects, and the official transparent RapWire mark.
rendered_body_text: RapWire’s verified Nov. 2 evening carousel follows Ice Cube and Mike Epps’ Listen & Laugh trailer, Vic Mensa’s producer-led 2027 album, Trippie Redd’s NDA Tour opening, The Weeknd’s Hong Kong release, and fresh GTA VI gameplay shown through South Park. Every slide pairs source-grounded reporting with original late-1980s editorial comic art, readable headline/deck layers, clear subjects, and the official transparent RapWire mark.
caption:
1) Ice Cube (@icecube) and Mike Epps (@mikeepps) just previewed the official Listen & Laugh trailer, with Dr. Dre, Regina King, T.I., The Game and more teased as guests. New episodes are scheduled Fridays at 6 PM ET/3 PM PT, giving the longtime collaborators another platform for music, movies, comedy and culture.
2) Vic Mensa (@vicmensa) says his planned 2027 album is the first where he is taking himself completely seriously as a producer. The project follows the return of Innanetape to streaming and his UnitedMasters partnership, a setup that keeps the next chapter artist-owned while expanding into music, media and design.
3) Trippie Redd (@trippieredd) opens The Non-Disclosure Agreement Tour tonight at The Fillmore Minneapolis. K Suave, BalloutDaDon, Gigi Holland and Goldie are listed alongside him, and the North American run is scheduled to continue through Dec. 22; the exact set list and any surprise guests remain unknown.
4) The Weeknd (@theweeknd) released “Hong Kong,” a city-specific song built from Faye Wong’s 1993 Cantopop classic “Monsoon.” He first performed it at Kai Tak Stadium, and the track’s East and Southeast Asia release turns the Hong Kong stop of his record-setting tour into a musical tribute to the region.
5) GTA VI’s world just got a strange new preview: an episode of South Park aired real gameplay showing Jason using dog waste as a weapon. Rockstar is thanked in the credits, confirming the footage came from the studio, and the moment spotlights the game’s promise of detailed, reactive world-building ahead of the Nov. 19 launch.

@Rapwire247
